title: Small-query seedwise three-CNF reduction
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean-valued PCPP system making $r$ possible queries, where $0<r<3$. Then there is a seedwise reduction with $K=r2^r$ auxiliary sign variables and clauses. For every seed it gives a CNF formula on the $r+K$ coordinates, with exactly $K$ nonempty clauses, each of width at most three; for every assignment to the $r$ queried bits, the verifier accepts its local transcript if and only if the formula is satisfiable by some assignment to the $K$ auxiliary variables.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a Boolean-valued PCPP system with $r$ possible queries
